before_rule.note: Article 26(1)(a): 20% final withholding on the gross dividend paid to a non-resident other than a permanent establishment in Indonesia, company or individual.

after_rule.note: Article26(1)(a) statutory 20% gross dividend baseline for nonresident recipients other than Indonesian permanent establishments. The 2023 consolidation preserves Article26(1b) interest-rate exceptions and Article26(5) exceptions to final withholding. This dividend-path rule is not a rate for every outbound payment, does not decide treaty entitlement, and does not calculate PE-attributable or status-changing recipient treatment.

scope: Primary citation rebinding only; existing statutory effect and temporal behavior unchanged. Full exceptional-recipient handling and historical decision notes still need review.

Atas penghasilan tersebut di bawah ini, dengan nama dan dalam bentuk apa pun, yang
dibayarkan, disediakan untuk dibayarkan, atau telah jatuh tempo pembayarannya oleh

selain bentuk usaha tetap di Indonesia dipotong pajak sebesar 20% (dua puluh persen)
dari jumlah bruto oleh pihak yang wajib membayarkan:
a.
dividen;
b.
bunga termasuk premium, diskonto, dan imbalan sehubungan dengan jaminan
pengembalian utang;
c.
royalti, sewa, dan penghasilan lain sehubungan dengan penggunaan harta;
d.
imbalan sehubungan dengan jasa, pekerjaan, dan kegiatan;
e.
hadiah dan penghargaan;
f.
pensiun dan pembayaran berkala lainnya;
g.

keuntungan karena pembebasan utang.
after_parameter.note: Article26(1) statutory 20% gross baseline for listed payments to nonresidents other than Indonesian permanent establishments; the dividend planner uses Article26(1)(a). Not the effective rate of every outbound payment: interest exceptions under Article26(1b), deemed-net bases under Article26(2), finality exceptions under Article26(5), and conditional treaty relief require separate rules. Rebinding evidence only; no inferred commencement date from this multi-act consolidation.
